{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01P8ab7GhxoYKUH9jmbHv46d","type":"tool_result","content":"#!/bin/sh\n# ledger: command-line cash ledger. Activates .venv when present and hands off to cli.main.\nset -eu\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\ncd \"$ROOT\"\nif [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then\n    # shellcheck disable=SC1091\n    set +u; . .venv/bin/activate; set -u\nfi\nexec python -c 'import sys; from cli import main; sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))' \"$@\"\n---\n\"\"\"Command registry: maps command words to handlers, filled from the modules in ``cli/commands/``.\"\"\"\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Any, NamedTuple\n\nfrom cli import commands\n\n\nclass Command(NamedTuple):\n    \"\"\"One registered command. ``max_args`` is ``None`` when the argument count is unbounded.\"\"\"\n\n    handler: Callable[[Any, list[str]], list[list[str]]]\n    min_args: int\n    max_args: int | None\n\n\n#: Command words, such as ``(\"account\", \"add\")``, mapped to their command.\nCOMMANDS: dict[tuple[str, ...], Command] = {}\n\n\ndef load() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Import every module in ``cli/commands/`` and add its ``COMMANDS``. Idempotent; never removes.\"\"\"\n    for module_info in pkgutil.iter_modules(commands.__path__):\n        module = importlib.import_module(f\"{commands.__name__}.{module_info.name}\")\n        COMMANDS.update(getattr(module, \"COMMANDS\", {}))\n---\n\"\"\"Command-line entry point for the ledger.\n\n``main`` resolves the command words, checks the argument count, opens the database, calls the\nhandler, and turns the result into CSV on stdout or one diagnostic line on stderr. It returns the\nexit code and never calls ``sys.exit``; the ``ledger`` launcher is the only caller that does.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli import registry\nfrom ledger_core.config import database_path\nfrom ledger_core.errors import LedgerError, Operational\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nEXIT_OK = 0\nEXIT_OPERATIONAL = 1\nEXIT_USAGE = 2\nPOSTGRES_PREFIXES = (\"postgres://\", \"postgresql://\")\n\n\ndef _usage_error(message: str) -> int:\n    print(f\"usage: {message}\", file=sys.stderr)\n    return EXIT_USAGE\n\n\ndef _open_store(location: str) -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the declared store. A SQLite file whose directory is absent is refused, not created.\n\n    The shipped SQLite driver creates a missing parent directory on connect, which would turn a\n    mistyped location into a new, empty store. The ledger's store is provisioned in advance.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not location.startswith(POSTGRES_PREFIXES):\n        parent = Path(location).parent\n        if not parent.is_dir():\n            raise Operational(f\"database directory does not exist: {parent}\")\n    return open_database(location)\n\n\ndef _match(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], registry.Command] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the longest command-word prefix of ``argv`` that is registered, with its command.\"\"\"\n    for length in range(len(argv), 0, -1):\n        words = tuple(argv[:length])\n        if words in registry.COMMANDS:\n            return words, registry.COMMANDS[words]\n    return None\n\n\ndef _format(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render rows as unquoted CSV with ``\\\\n`` line endings.\"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(\",\".join(str(value) for value in row) + \"\\n\" for row in rows)\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else list(argv)\n    registry.load()\n\n    matched = _match(argv)\n    if matched is None:\n        return _usage_error(f\"unknown command {' '.join(argv)!r}\" if argv else \"no command given\")\n    words, command = matched\n\n    args = argv[len(words):]\n    if len(args) < command.min_args or (command.max_args is not None and len(args) > command.max_args):\n        return _usage_error(f\"wrong number of arguments for {' '.join(words)!r}\")\n\n    try:\n        database = _open_store(database_path())\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: cannot open database: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n\n    try:\n        rows = command.handler(database, args)\n    except LedgerError as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n    finally:\n        database.close()\n\n    sys.stdout.write(_format(rows))\n    return EXIT_OK\n---\n\"\"\"Command modules. Each module exposes a ``COMMANDS`` mapping from command words to commands.\"\"\"\n---\n\"\"\"Maintenance commands: ``ledger init`` empties the ledger, ``ledger count`` reports table row counts.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.config import database_path\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError, open_database\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\n\nSCHEMA_SQL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"schema.sql\"\n\n\ndef _ensure_schema() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the declared tables when the configured store has none. A provisioned store is left alone.\n\n    This runs on its own connection, before the command's connection first reads. Inside the\n    acceptance harness the command's connection is joined to the harness transaction, which forbids\n    schema SQL and would keep a pre-schema snapshot, so the harness is detached only while the\n    standalone connection is opened. Nothing is written when the tables already exist.\n    \"\"\"\n    harness = persistence_db._harness\n    persistence_db._harness = None\n    try:\n        bootstrap = open_database(database_path())\n    finally:\n        persistence_db._harness = harness\n    try:\n        try:\n            bootstrap.transactions.list()\n        except PersistenceError:\n            bootstrap.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    finally:\n        bootstrap.close()\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema()\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n---\n\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add|get|rename|delete``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nDELETED_HEADER = [\"deleted\"]\n\n\ndef _account_rows(db, code: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return the header and the live row for ``code``; raise ``NotFound`` when it is absent.\"\"\"\n    row = account_row(db, code)\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    account, name, transactions, cents = row\n    return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [account, name, str(transactions), format_cents(cents)]]\n\n\ndef account_add(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate, reject a duplicate code, insert the account, and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code = validate_code(args[0])\n    name = validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Print the account's live row. Read-only; an absent code exits 4.\"\"\"\n    return _account_rows(db, args[0])\n\n\ndef account_rename(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate the new name, then change only the name of an existing account and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code, name = args[0], validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    db.accounts.update(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove an account that has no transactions. Existence and use are both checked first.\"\"\"\n    code = args[0]\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    if db.transactions.list(account=code):\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n    db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [code]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"account\", \"add\"): Command(account_add, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"get\"): Command(account_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"account\", \"rename\"): Command(account_rename, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"delete\"): Command(account_delete, 1, 1),\n}\n---\n\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n---\n\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n---\n\"\"\"Domain errors. Each carries the process exit code the CLI reports.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Base class for every domain error the ledger raises.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Invalid input, duplicate key, unknown reference, account in use, or negative balance.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An account or transaction is absent on get, rename, delete, or amend.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An unreadable file or an unopenable database.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n---\n\"\"\"Domain logic for the cash ledger.\n\nOwnership: only the generated ``persistence`` package touches the database.\nModules here never import a database driver, and money is integer cents\neverywhere; floating point is never used for money.\n\"\"\"","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5f95ed8b-fe97-48f5-ab50-dccb503b93f4","uuid":"ff3d4a33-3131-4d3d-af56-a0654e7bc3d0","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:57:37.411Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"#!/bin/sh\n# ledger: command-line cash ledger. Nothing is written when the tables already exist.\n    \"\"\"\n    harness = persistence_db._harness\n    persistence_db._harness = None\n    try:\n        bootstrap = open_database(database_path())\n    finally:\n        persistence_db._harness = harness\n    try:\n        try:\n            bootstrap.transactions.list()\n        except PersistenceError:\n            bootstrap.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    finally:\n        bootstrap.close()\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema()\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n---\n\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add|get|rename|delete``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nDELETED_HEADER = [\"deleted\"]\n\n\ndef _account_rows(db, code: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return the header and the live row for ``code``; raise ``NotFound`` when it is absent.\"\"\"\n    row = account_row(db, code)\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    account, name, transactions, cents = row\n    return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [account, name, str(transactions), format_cents(cents)]]\n\n\ndef account_add(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate, reject a duplicate code, insert the account, and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code = validate_code(args[0])\n    name = validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Print the account's live row. Read-only; an absent code exits 4.\"\"\"\n    return _account_rows(db, args[0])\n\n\ndef account_rename(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate the new name, then change only the name of an existing account and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code, name = args[0], validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    db.accounts.update(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove an account that has no transactions. Existence and use are both checked first.\"\"\"\n    code = args[0]\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    if db.transactions.list(account=code):\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n    db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [code]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"account\", \"add\"): Command(account_add, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"get\"): Command(account_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"account\", \"rename\"): Command(account_rename, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"delete\"): Command(account_delete, 1, 1),\n}\n---\n\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n---\n\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n---\n\"\"\"Domain errors. Each carries the process exit code the CLI reports.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Base class for every domain error the ledger raises.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Invalid input, duplicate key, unknown reference, account in use, or negative balance.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An account or transaction is absent on get, rename, delete, or amend.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An unreadable file or an unopenable database.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n---\n\"\"\"Domain logic for the cash ledger.\n\nOwnership: only the generated ``persistence`` package touches the database.\nModules here never import a database driver, and money is integer cents\neverywhere; floating point is never used for money.\n\"\"\"","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01P8ab7GhxoYKUH9jmbHv46d","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019xXpuc6pwVvAagdbs4mVzJ","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Transaction commands: ``ledger txn post|get|delete|amend``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Delete, Edit, Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import next_txn_id, parse_txn_id, txn_row\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_date, validate_memo\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nDELETED_HEADER = [\"deleted\"]\n\n\ndef txn_post(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check every input and the balance rule, then insert one transaction and print its row.\n\n    All checks run before the insert, so a rejected post stores nothing.\n    \"\"\"\n    account, category = args[0], args[1]\n    cents = parse_amount(args[2])\n    day = validate_date(args[3])\n    memo = validate_memo(args[4] if len(args) == 5 else \"\")\n    if db.accounts.get(account=account) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {account} does not exist\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=category) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"category {category} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents)])\n    txn = db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=next_txn_id(db), date=day, account=account, category=category, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef txn_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Print one stored transaction. Read-only; a non-integer id exits 3 and an absent id exits 4.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if txn is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef txn_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove a transaction unless its account balance would go below zero without it.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    if db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Delete(txn_id=txn_id)])\n    db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [str(txn_id)]]\n\n\ndef txn_amend(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Change only the amount of a transaction, and only when its account stays at or above zero.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    cents = parse_amount(args[1])\n    if db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Edit(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)])\n    txn = db.transactions.update(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"txn\", \"post\"): Command(txn_post, 4, 5),\n    (\"txn\", \"get\"): Command(txn_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"txn\", \"delete\"): Command(txn_delete, 1, 1),\n    (\"txn\", \"amend\"): Command(txn_amend, 2, 2),\n}\n---\n\"\"\"``ledger load`` commands: ``accounts`` and ``categories`` are all-or-nothing bulk loads.\n\nEvery row of the file is checked before the first write: the key, the text, the key's repetition\nwithin the file, and the key's presence in the store. The rows are then inserted through\n``ledger_core.atomic.run_all``, so a failing insert removes the rows already stored.\n\n``transactions`` keeps each file ``txn_id`` and checks the foreign keys, date, amount, memo, repeats,\nand the balance rule over the whole file before its first write.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.atomic import run_all\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import parse_txn_id\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_date, validate_memo, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = (\"account\", \"name\")\nCATEGORY_HEADER = (\"category\", \"description\")\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef _checked_rows(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; return ``(key, text)`` pairs in file order.\"\"\"\n    already_stored = set(stored)\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    for line, (key_text, text) in read_rows(path, header):\n        try:\n            key = validate_key(key_text)\n            validate_name(text)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} repeats within the file\")\n        if key in already_stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n        checked.append((key, text))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _load(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    table: str,\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n    create: Callable[[str, str], object],\n    remove: Callable[[str], object],\n) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check the whole file, insert every row as one unit, and report the loaded count.\"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_rows(path, header, validate_key, stored)\n    run_all([(_insert(create, key, text), _remove(remove, key)) for key, text in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(len(checked))]]\n\n\ndef _insert(create: Callable[[str, str], object], key: str, text: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: create(key, text)\n\n\ndef _remove(remove: Callable[[str], object], key: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: remove(key)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``account,name`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        ACCOUNT_HEADER,\n        \"accounts\",\n---\n\"\"\"Transaction rows: formatting a stored transaction for output, the next free id, and id parsing.\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom persistence import Database\nfrom persistence.schema import (\n    TransactionsCreateOutput,\n    TransactionsGetOutput,\n    TransactionsListOutput,\n    TransactionsUpdateOutput,\n)\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\nStoredTxn = Union[TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput, TransactionsUpdateOutput]\n\n_TXN_ID = re.compile(r\"-?[0-9]+\")\n\n\ndef parse_txn_id(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse a transaction id written as an integer. Any other text is rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str) or _TXN_ID.fullmatch(text) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"transaction id must be an integer: {text!r}\")\n    return int(text)\n\n\ndef txn_row(txn: StoredTxn) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Format a stored transaction as the output row ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo``.\"\"\"\n    return [str(txn.txn_id), txn.date, txn.account, txn.category, format_cents(txn.amount), txn.memo]\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db: Database) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the largest stored ``txn_id`` plus one, or ``1`` when the ledger has no transactions.\"\"\"\n    return max((txn.txn_id for txn in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n---\n\"\"\"Account rows: the stored account and the live figures the account commands report.\n\n``account_row`` computes the transaction count and the integer-cent balance from the database on\nevery call, so neither figure is stored or embedded.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nAccountRow = tuple[str, str, int, int]\n\n\ndef account_row(db: Database, code: str) -> AccountRow | None:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(account, name, transactions, balance_cents)``, or ``None`` when the account is absent.\"\"\"\n    account = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    if account is None:\n        return None\n    posted = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return (account.account, account.name, len(posted), sum(txn.amount for txn in posted))\n---\n\"\"\"Pure validation of codes, names, memos, and dates.\n\nEach function returns the validated value unchanged, or raises ``Rejected``. Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in _FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must not contain a comma or newline\")\n\n\ndef validate_code(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 12 characters, each ``A-Z`` or ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"code\")\n    if not _CODE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_name(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"name\")\n    _check_length(text, \"name\", 1, NAME_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"name\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_memo(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"memo\")\n    _check_length(text, \"memo\", 0, MEMO_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"memo\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept a real calendar date written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"date\")\n    match = _DATE.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(\"date must be written YYYY-MM-DD\")\n    year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date is not a real calendar date: {text}\") from exc\n    return value\n---\n\"\"\"Shared CSV reader for the ``ledger load`` commands.\n\nThe reader only reads: it never touches the database and never writes to a file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\n\nRow = tuple[int, list[str]]\n\n\ndef read_rows(path: str, header: Sequence[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(line_number, fields)`` for every data row of ``path``, in file order.\n\n    ``header`` lists the column names the table requires, in order. Line numbers are 1-based, so the\n    first data row after a header on line 1 is line 2. Blank lines are skipped. Raises ``Operational``\n    when the file cannot be read or decoded, and ``Rejected`` when the header differs, the file is\n    empty, or a data row's field count differs from ``len(header)``.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            return _read(fh, path, list(header))\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc.strerror or exc}\") from exc\n    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot decode {path} as UTF-8: {exc}\") from exc\n\n\ndef _read(fh, path: str, header: list[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    reader = csv.reader(fh)\n    try:\n        first = next(reader, None)\n        if first is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} is empty; expected header {','.join(header)}\")\n        if first != header:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line 1: header must be {','.join(header)}\")\n        rows: list[Row] = []\n        for fields in reader:\n            if not fields:\n                continue\n            if len(fields) != len(header):\n                raise Rejected(\n                    f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: expected {len(header)} fields, found {len(fields)}\"\n                )\n            rows.append((reader.line_num, fields))\n        return rows\n    except csv.Error as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}\") from exc\n---\n\"\"\"Balance rule: changes are judged by net effect per account, and a check never writes.\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Delete, Edit, Insert, check_no_negative, current_balance\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nCATEGORY = \"ZZBRCAT\"\n\n\ndef _seed(db, account, amounts, first_txn_id):\n    db.accounts.create(account=account, name=\"Balance Test\")\n    db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Balance Cat\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=first_txn_id + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=account,\n                               category=CATEGORY, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\ndef _count(db, *accounts):\n    return sum(len(db.transactions.list(account=account)) for account in accounts)\n\n\ndef test_current_balance_sums_stored_amounts():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRA\", [1000, -300, -50], 910000001)\n        assert current_balance(db, \"ZZBRA\") == 650\n\n\ndef test_current_balance_is_zero_for_account_without_transactions():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZBRE\", name=\"Empty Test\")\n        assert current_balance(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRB\", -700)]) is None\n\n\ndef test_insert_one_cent_below_zero_is_rejected_and_writes_nothing():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRC\", [700], 910000021)\n        before = _count(db, \"ZZBRC\")\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRC\", -701)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 3\n        assert with pytest.raises(NotFound) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Edit(919999999, 100)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 4\n        with pytest.raises(NotFound):\n            check_no_negative(db, [Delete(919999999)])\n\n\ndef test_combined_changes_judged_by_net_effect_in_either_order():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRG\", [700], 910000051)\n        credit, debit = Insert(\"ZZBRG\", 500), Insert(\"ZZBRG\", -1100)\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [credit, debit]) is None\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [debit, credit]) is None\n\n\ndef test_combined_changes_netting_below_zero_are_rejected():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRH\", [700], 910000061)\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected):\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRH\", 500), Insert(\"ZZBRH\", -1300)])\n\n\ndef test_one_overdrawn_account_rejects_whole_set_and_writes_nothing():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, memo=memo\n    )\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef txn_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Print one stored transaction. Read-only; a non-integer id exits 3 and an absent id exits 4.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if txn is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef txn_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove a transaction unless its account balance would go below zero without it.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    if db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Delete(txn_id=txn_id)])\n    db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [str(txn_id)]]\n\n\ndef txn_amend(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Change only the amount of a transaction, and only when its account stays at or above zero.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    cents = parse_amount(args[1])\n    if db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Edit(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)])\n    txn = db.transactions.update(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"txn\", \"post\"): Command(txn_post, 4, 5),\n    (\"txn\", \"get\"): Command(txn_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"txn\", \"delete\"): Command(txn_delete, 1, 1),\n    (\"txn\", \"amend\"): Command(txn_amend, 2, 2),\n}\n---\n\"\"\"``ledger load`` commands: ``accounts`` and ``categories`` are all-or-nothing bulk loads.\n\nEvery row of the file is checked before the first write: the key, the text, the key's repetition\nwithin the file, and the key's presence in the store. The rows are then inserted through\n``ledger_core.atomic.run_all``, so a failing insert removes the rows already stored.\n\n``transactions`` keeps each file ``txn_id`` and checks the foreign keys, date, amount, memo, repeats,\nand the balance rule over the whole file before its first write.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.atomic import run_all\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import parse_txn_id\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_date, validate_memo, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = (\"account\", \"name\")\nCATEGORY_HEADER = (\"category\", \"description\")\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef _checked_rows(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; return ``(key, text)`` pairs in file order.\"\"\"\n    already_stored = set(stored)\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    for line, (key_text, text) in read_rows(path, header):\n        try:\n            key = validate_key(key_text)\n            validate_name(text)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} repeats within the file\")\n        if key in already_stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n        checked.append((key, text))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _load(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    table: str,\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n    create: Callable[[str, str], object],\n    remove: Callable[[str], object],\n) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check the whole file, insert every row as one unit, and report the loaded count.\"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_rows(path, header, validate_key, stored)\n    run_all([(_insert(create, key, text), _remove(remove, key)) for key, text in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(len(checked))]]\n\n\ndef _insert(create: Callable[[str, str], object], key: str, text: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: create(key, text)\n\n\ndef _remove(remove: Callable[[str], object], key: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: remove(key)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``account,name`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        ACCOUNT_HEADER,\n        \"accounts\",\n---\n\"\"\"Transaction rows: formatting a stored transaction for output, the next free id, and id parsing.\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom persistence import Database\nfrom persistence.schema import (\n    TransactionsCreateOutput,\n    TransactionsGetOutput,\n    TransactionsListOutput,\n    TransactionsUpdateOutput,\n)\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\nStoredTxn = Union[TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput, TransactionsUpdateOutput]\n\n_TXN_ID = re.compile(r\"-?[0-9]+\")\n\n\ndef parse_txn_id(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse a transaction id written as an integer. Any other text is rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str) or _TXN_ID.fullmatch(text) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"transaction id must be an integer: {text!r}\")\n    return int(text)\n\n\ndef txn_row(txn: StoredTxn) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Format a stored transaction as the output row ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo``.\"\"\"\n    return [str(txn.txn_id), txn.date, txn.account, txn.category, format_cents(txn.amount), txn.memo]\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db: Database) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the largest stored ``txn_id`` plus one, or ``1`` when the ledger has no transactions.\"\"\"\n    return max((txn.txn_id for txn in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n---\n\"\"\"Account rows: the stored account and the live figures the account commands report.\n\n``account_row`` computes the transaction count and the integer-cent balance from the database on\nevery call, so neither figure is stored or embedded.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nAccountRow = tuple[str, str, int, int]\n\n\ndef account_row(db: Database, code: str) -> AccountRow | None:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(account, name, transactions, balance_cents)``, or ``None`` when the account is absent.\"\"\"\n    account = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    if account is None:\n        return None\n    posted = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return (account.account, account.name, len(posted), sum(txn.amount for txn in posted))\n---\n\"\"\"Pure validation of codes, names, memos, and dates.\n\nEach function returns the validated value unchanged, or raises ``Rejected``. Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in _FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must not contain a comma or newline\")\n\n\ndef validate_code(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 12 characters, each ``A-Z`` or ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"code\")\n    if not _CODE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_name(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"name\")\n    _check_length(text, \"name\", 1, NAME_MAX)\n \"memo\")\n    _check_length(text, \"memo\", 0, MEMO_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"memo\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept a real calendar date written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"date\")\n    match = _DATE.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(\"date must be written YYYY-MM-DD\")\n    year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date is not a real calendar date: {text}\") from exc\n    return value\n---\n\"\"\"Shared CSV reader for the ``ledger load`` commands.\n\nThe reader only reads: it never touches the database and never writes to a {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JwjbPp6n1BBvkRPY5WeoTL","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"``ledger account get``, ``rename``, and ``delete``, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nCATEGORY = \"ZMAC1\"\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _name(store_open, path, code):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n        return None if row is None else row.name\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef account_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Manage Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _post(store_open, path, code, txn_id, cents):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=code, category=CATEGORY, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_reports_live_count_and_balance(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG1\", \"Get Probe\")\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG1\", 1, 1000)\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG1\", 2, -250)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG1\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZMG1\", \"Get Probe\", \"2\", \"7.50\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_empty_account_reports_zero_count_and_zero_balance(account_store):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG2\", \"Empty Probe\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG2\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"ZMG2\", \"Empty Probe\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_reflects_a_posting_made_after_the_last_read(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG3\", \"Live\")\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG3\")[1])[1] == [\"ZMG3\", \"Live\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG3\", 5, 4200)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG3\")[1])[1] == [\"ZMG3\", \"Live\", \"1\", \"42.00\"]\n\n---\n\"\"\"Fixtures shared by the command tests: a fresh, initialised ledger store per test under ``tmp_path``.\n\nCLI writes commit to their own connection, so these tests point ``DATABASE_URL`` at a private file.\nThat keeps ``data/app.db`` out of reach of anything a command does.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef ledger_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Point the ledger at an empty, initialised store and return its path.\"\"\"\n    path = tmp_path / \"ledger.db\"\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", str(path))\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", raising=False)\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    return path\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef store_open():\n    \"\"\"Open the store at a path for read-back through the persistence interface.\"\"\"\n\n    def opener(path):\n        return open_database(str(path))\n\n    return opener\n---\n\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the ledger test suite.\n\nThe ``db_session`` and ``cli_runner`` fixtures delegate to helpers owned by the\ngenerated ``persistence`` package and the ``cli`` package. Those packages arrive\nwith their own stories, so the imports stay inside the fixtures until then.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef db_session():\n    \"\"\"Provisioned application {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSwNR3RwcmHMwJH651Ep","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WaXGxcrEqhcVhjKSreATAX","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/reports.py","content":"\"\"\"Report arithmetic: transaction counts and cash flows computed in integer cents.\n\nPure functions over amounts in cents. Nothing here touches storage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\n\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\n\ndef flows(amounts: Iterable[int]) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(count, inflow, outflow, net)`` in cents.\n\n    ``inflow`` is the sum of positive amounts, ``outflow`` the sum of the magnitudes of negative\n    amounts (written positive), and ``net`` is ``inflow - outflow``. No amounts gives all zeros.\n    \"\"\"\n    values = list(amounts)\n    inflow = sum(value for value in values if value > 0)\n    outflow = sum(-value for value in values if value < 0)\n    return len(values), inflow, outflow, inflow - outflow\n\n\ndef flow_cells(amounts: Iterable[int]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Return the report cells ``[transactions, inflow, outflow, net]`` for ``amounts``, formatted.\"\"\"\n    count, inflow, outflow, net = flows(amounts)\n    return [str(count), format_cents(inflow), format_cents(outflow), format_cents(net)]\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3516,"cache_read_input_tokens":49907,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3516},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5f95ed8b-fe97-48f5-ab50-dccb503b93f4","uuid":"917504db-da7f-40c2-8958-453e96cb0455","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:58:01.454Z","request_id":"req_011CgSwNQjZtBmZyuaT51BKj","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01WaXGxcrEqhcVhjKSreATAX":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/reports.py","content":"\"\"\"Report arithmetic: transaction counts and cash flows computed in integer cents.\n\nPure functions over amounts in cents. Nothing here touches storage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\n\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\n\ndef flows(amounts: Iterable[int]) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(count, inflow, outflow, net)`` in cents.\n\n    ``inflow`` is the sum of positive amounts, ``outflow`` the sum of the magnitudes of negative\n    amounts (written positive), and ``net`` is ``inflow - outflow``. No amounts gives all zeros.\n    \"\"\"\n    values = list(amounts)\n    inflow = sum(value for value in values if value > 0)\n    outflow = sum(-value for value in values if value < 0)\n    return len(values), inflow, outflow, inflow - outflow\n\n\ndef flow_cells(amounts: Iterable[int]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Return the report cells ``[transactions, inflow, outflow, net]`` for ``amounts``, formatted.\"\"\"\n    count, inflow, outflow, net = flows(amounts)\n    return [str(count), format_cents(inflow), format_cents(outflow), format_cents(net)]\n"}}}

No row,\ncount, or total is embedded, and nothing is written to the database.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.reports import flow_cells\n\nBALANCES_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nMONTHLY_HEADER = [\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\nCATEGORIES_HEADER = [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n\n\ndef report_balances(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row per account by code with its transaction count and balance, then the TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n    amounts_by_account: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    all_amounts: list[int] = []\n    for txn in db.transactions.list():\n        amounts_by_account.setdefault(txn.account, []).append(txn.amount)\n        all_amounts.append(txn.amount)\n    rows = [BALANCES_HEADER]\n    for account in sorted(db.accounts.list(), key=lambda row: row.account):\n        mine = amounts_by_account.get(account.account, [])\n        rows.append([account.account, account.name, str(len(mine)), format_cents(sum(mine))])\n    rows.append([\"TOTAL\", \"\", str(len(all_amounts)), format_cents(sum(all_amounts))])\n    return rows\n\n\ndef report_monthly(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row per ``YYYY-MM`` that has transactions, ascending, then the TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n    amounts_by_month: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    all_amounts: list[int] = []\n    for txn in db.transactions.list():\n rows.append([month, *flow_cells(amounts_by_month[month])])\n    rows.append([\"TOTAL\", *flow_cells(all_amounts)])\n    return rows\n\n\ndef report_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row per category by code, including categories with no transactions, then the TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n    amounts_by_category: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    all_amounts: No row,\ncount, or total is embedded, and nothing is written to the database.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.reports import flow_cells\n\nBALANCES_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nMONTHLY_HEADER = [\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\nCATEGORIES_HEADER = [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n\n\ndef report_balances(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row per account by code with its transaction count and balance, then the TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n    amounts_by_account: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    all_amounts: list[int] = []\n    for txn in db.transactions.list():\n        amounts_by_account.setdefault(txn.account, []).append(txn.amount)\n        all_amounts.append(txn.amount)\n    rows = [BALANCES_HEADER]\n    for account in sorted(db.accounts.list(), key=lambda row: row.account):\n        mine = amounts_by_account.get(account.account, [])\n        rows.append([account.account, account.name, str(len(mine)), format_cents(sum(mine))])\n    rows.append([\"TOTAL\", \"\", str(len(all_amounts)), format_cents(sum(all_amounts))])\n    return rows\n\n\ndef report_monthly(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row per ``YYYY-MM`` that has transactions, ascending, then the TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n    amounts_by_month: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    all_amounts: list[int] = []\n    for txn in db.transactions.list():\n        amounts_by_month.setdefault(txn.date[:7], []).append(txn.amount)\n        all_amounts.append(txn.amount)\n    rows = [MONTHLY_HEADER]\n    for month in sorted(amounts_by_month):\n        rows.append([month, *flow_cells(amounts_by_month[month])])\n    rows.append([\"TOTAL\", *flow_cells(all_amounts)])\n    return rows\n\n\ndef report_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row per category by code, including categories with no transactions, then the TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n    amounts_by_category: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    all_amounts: list[int] = []\n    for txn in db.transactions.list():\n        amounts_by_category.setdefault(txn.category, []).append(txn.amount)\n        all_amounts.append(txn.amount)\n    rows = [CATEGORIES_HEADER]\n    for category in sorted(db.categories.list(), key=lambda row: row.category):\n        mine = amounts_by_category.get(category.category, [])\n        rows.append([category.category, category.description, *flow_cells(mine)])\n    rows.append([\"TOTAL\", \"\", *flow_cells(all_amounts)])\n    return rows\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"report\", \"balances\"): Command(report_balances, 0, 0),\n    (\"report\", \"monthly\"): Command(report_monthly, 0, 0),\n    (\"report\", \"categories\"): Command(report_categories, 0, 0),\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01HKxYsYugUHKzTPQfothtjA","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSwPxptzFMSpJaE37i4z","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XHsvPmnGTWDFhM7qg8qChs","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_reports.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger report balances|monthly|categories`` and the report arithmetic, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom ledger_core.reports import flow_cells, flows\n\nBALANCES_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nMONTHLY_HEADER = [\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\nCATEGORIES_HEADER = [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n\n# (txn_id, date, account, category, cents). Hand-computed expectations are written out in the tests.\nDATASET = [\n    (1, \"2026-01-05\", \"ZRB1\", \"ZRCA\", 100050),\n    (2, \"2026-01-20\", \"ZRB1\", \"ZRCA\", -2505),\n    (3, \"2026-03-02\", \"ZRB1\", \"ZRCA\", -7),\n    (4, \"2026-03-03\", \"ZRB2\", \"ZRCB\", -1000),\n]\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef base(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"Three accounts (created out of code order), three categories, and no transactions.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZRB3\", name=\"Idle\")\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZRB2\", name=\"Bal Two\")\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZRB1\", name=\"Bal One\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZRCC\", description=\"Cat C\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZRCB\", description=\"Cat B\")\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZRCA\", description=\"Cat A\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _post_dataset(store_open, path, rows=DATASET):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        for txn_id, date, account, category, cents in rows:\n            db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=account, category=category,\n                                   amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\n# ── pure arithmetic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_flows_of_no_amounts_are_all_zero():\n    assert flows([]) == (0, 0, 0, 0)\n\n\ndef test_flows_separate_inflow_from_outflow_and_net_is_their_difference():\n    assert flows([500, -200, -50]) == (3, 500, 250, 250)\n\n\ndef test_flow_cells_write_outflow_positive_and_negative_net_with_sign():\n    assert flow_cells([-1007]) == [\"1\", \"0.00\", \"10.07\", \"-10.07\"]\n\n\n# ── balances ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_balances_report_count_and_balance_per_account_with_total(base, store_open):\n    _post_dataset(store_open, base)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [\n        BALANCES_HEADER,\n        [\"ZRB1\", \"Bal One\", \"3\", \"975.38\"],\n        [\"ZRB2\", \"Bal Two\", \"1\", \"-10.00\"],\n        [\"ZRB3\", \"Idle\", \"0\", \"0.00\"],\n        [\"TOTAL\", \"\", \"4\", \"965.38\"],\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_balances_list_accounts_by_code_regardless_of_creation_order(base):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert [row[0] for row in _rows(out)[1:-1]] == [\"ZRB1\", \"ZRB2\", \"ZRB3\"]\n\n\ndef test_balances_account_without_transactions_is_zero(base):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[3] == [\"ZRB3\", \"Idle\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_balances_total_row_is_sum_of_account_rows(base, store_open):\n    _post_dataset(store_open, base)\n    rows = _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")[1])\n    body, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(row[2]) for row in body)\n    assert total[3] == \"965.38\"\n\n\ndef test_balances_empty_ledger_is_zero_total_row_only(ledger_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [BALANCES_HEADER, [\"TOTAL\", \"\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n\n\ndef test_balances_output_has_newline_endings_and_no_trailing_spaces(base, store_open):\n    _post_dataset(store_open, base)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\",
